recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key studio portrait of a woman in 1970s attire, set against a deep black, textured background. The subject is seated, wearing a patterned floral dress in warm earth tones, with hands clasped near her face. The typography is characterized by high-contrast serifs with decorative swashes, positioned at the top and upper-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically but offset to the right, balanced by left-aligned text.
Warm floral patterns in the dress contrast against the cold, dark void of the background.
The decorative swash of the primary text mirrors the organic curves of the subject's hair and dress patterns.
coreInvariants: Deep black background with subtle circular grain or texture.
Warm color palette (ochre, terracotta, cream) for the subject's clothing.
High-contrast serif typography with exaggerated swashes on capital letters.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-full shot, positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, seated and leaning forward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and clasped hands form the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large white text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the flow of the patterned dress toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space on the left side and around the subject, creating a spotlight effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Matte black background providing high contrast for all elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for primary display text for maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Terracotta, ochre, and muted red within the floral dress patterns.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white text and black background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and monochrome

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical strokes with very thin horizontals and serifs.
Exaggerated, circular swashes on the terminals of capital letters like 'M' and 'J'.
Tight letter spacing (kerning) with occasional overlaps.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'M' features a long, curling swash extending from the left leg.
Capital 'J' features a deep, rounded hook.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, bold swash serif for the main title paired with a smaller, condensed version of the same style for secondary information.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the iconic 70s decorative serif look with similar terminals.
Provides the high contrast and vintage feel required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with 70s-style hair, wearing a warm-toned floral maxi dress, seated in a dark environment with low-key lighting and a textured black background. Leave the top and left areas clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in a bold white Bookman-style swash serif at the top. Add secondary tracklist-style text in a smaller, cream-colored condensed serif in the upper left quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the background a deep, textured black?
Do the capital letters in the title have decorative swashes?
Is the subject's clothing in warm earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the floral pattern on the dress
Degree of swash decoration on the typography
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or record label logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark background.
Check that the swashes do not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the film grain looks organic rather than digital noise.
Confirm the composition maintains a balance between the subject and the negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key 70s portrait with high-contrast swash serif typography and a warm, earth-toned color palette against a textured black void.
